forms.label: Red, liquid
forms.sourceNote: USDA publishes no record for liquid food colouring. It is used a few drops to a teaspoon at a time and its nutrition is nutritionally negligible; figures are set to zero rather than borrowed from an unrelated food, and the cited record is retained only to satisfy the schema's source fields.
forms.nutritionCaveat: Set to zero rather than measured: liquid food colouring is used in drops, and no USDA record describes it.
